summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) class with the eleven members, values, and comments from the spec. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean. It uses the bridge's variant and DualStack lookups and the existing S3/STS predicates, and it omits SDK::Endpoint when no value applies. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 24 scenario tests. Verification: test_args.py, test_client.py, test_regions.py, and test_utils.py pass (694 tests) using the prepared venv Python. No new lines exceed 79 columns; one pre-existing over-length line in args.py was left unchanged. black and isort were not run because the venv lacks them. Nothing was committed.
